objective: Compare last-5/10/20/30 competitive score baselines with recency-weighted national-team attack/defence models; select and calibrate before final evaluation.
primary_cohort: Both teams UEFA members, competitive senior men; auxiliary covered global competitive cohort and UNL league phase reported separately.
feature_definition: Attack-side log((GF recent+0.5)/(GF last30+0.5)) and opponent-side log((GA recent+0.5)/(GA last30+0.5)); windows use competitive matches only and three-day guard.
selection: Best primary selection-period metric per target, same match coverage. Record all 12 candidates; fixed alphabetical tie-break. No selection using final-test results.
calibration: Fit one multinomial temperature plus home/draw biases for 1X2, or sigmoid intercept/slope for each binary target, on primary 2020-2021 predictions. Calibrated version fixed as primary before reading final-test scores. Raw version secondary diagnostic only.
promotion_gate: Research candidate per target only if calibrated final-test primary loss improves vs pooled5 overall and in each two-year block, paired monthly bootstrap interval excludes no improvement, and UNL league-phase loss also improves. No automatic operational replacement; no claim all targets improve. Prospective confirmation still required.
normal_time_policy: Use goal-event counts at minute<=90 only when per-team event totals reconcile with full-time score and all minutes parse.
Known UEFA round-robin league/qualification formats and ordinary Friendly matches cannot have extra time; retain full-time score with format provenance.
Exclude other goal-bearing matches without reconciled minute coverage; never silently mix 120-minute scores.
Log duplicate conflicts, missing/invalid scores, unknown minutes and all exclusions before model performance inspection.
data_limitations: Source downloaded now; historical availability uses date-only conservative guard, not archived T-24 exact timestamps.
Retrospective outcome knowledge and source revisions prevent a claim of blind prospective validation.
Player form, squad continuity, coaching changes, injuries, xG and current market are unavailable in this corpus and not assigned invented coefficients.
Friendly training is a separately tested candidate; last-N competitive form remains separate.
No profitability or market-edge claims without comparable historical prices.
